description: Send a support request from an agent to the BuyingMesh operator by email. Never include private keys, passwords or payment secrets.

agentId.description: Stable calling agent identifier for support correlation.

context.description: Optional structured diagnostic context. Exclude secrets.

message.description: Clear support question or issue. Do not include passwords, private keys or payment secrets.

page.description: Optional page, endpoint or resource where the issue occurred.

replyTo.description: Optional email address where the operator can reply.

subject.description: Short email subject for the operator.

name: contact_support

outputSchema.description: Accepted support request with an operator correlation ID.
